title: FUEL WING TK IMBALANCE
_note: Text-triggered: an inter-tank delta can't be expressed with the single-dataref condition tree. A left/right-delta trigger form is a candidate schema extension (see docs).

actions.say: Confirm the imbalance is real and not a gauging fault; identify the heavier tank.
On the lower tank, both pumps, off, so the heavier tank feeds both engines.
Monitor, and when the balance is restored, pumps on and crossfeed closed.

status: Status. Fuel imbalance being corrected by crossfeed.
Observe the maximum permitted imbalance for landing in the Q.R.H.
Do not forget to close the crossfeed and restore the pumps once balanced.
